consistency_log.description: Deliverable ID and naming consistency across all three sections
consistency_log.source_basis: excellence_section.json sub_section 1.1 (deliverable titles and months); impact_section.json sub_sections 2.2–2.3 (deliverable titles and months); implementation_section.json sub_section 3.1 (deliverable table). Six deliverables referenced consistently across sections: D1-01 (Diagnostic model specification and calibration report, month 14, WP1), D2-01 (Decision engine and demonstrator software, month 20, WP2), D3-01 (Field validation dataset and uncertainty calibration report, month 24, WP3), D4-01 (Career Development Plan, month 3, WP4), D5-01 (Data Management Plan, month 6, WP5), D5-02 (Dissemination and exploitation plan, month 6, WP5). Names, WP attributions, and due months are consistent across all three sections. No deliverable is described as a KPI; KPI-tracked outcomes (e.g., 90% PI coverage per RQ5) are consistently framed as validation criteria, not as deliverables.

consistency_log.description: Milestone ID consistency across Impact and Implementation sections
consistency_log.source_basis: implementation_section.json milestone_refs [MS1, MS2, MS3, MS4, MS5, MS6] and sub_section 3.1 milestone definitions; impact_section.json sub_sections 2.3.3–2.3.4. The Implementation section defines six milestones (MS1 month 6, MS2 month 12, MS3 month 15, MS4 month 18, MS5 month 22, MS6 month 24), each with verifiable criteria. The Impact and Excellence sections organise content by outcomes, impact pathways, and deliverables rather than by explicit milestone IDs; this is a structural difference in presentation, not a contradiction. No milestone ID appears in the Impact or Excellence sections that conflicts with or is absent from the Implementation milestone registry. MS4 (research demonstrator, month 18) is referenced contextually in the Impact section in relation to farmer feedback; the description is consistent with the Implementation section definition.

excellence_section.json sub_section 1.1 (RQ5 criterion: '90% prediction intervals must contain the measured ground-truth value approximately 90% of the time'; RQ6: water-use efficiency); impact_section.json sub_section 2.3.2 (same RQ5 criterion verbatim); implementation_section.json sub_section 3.1 MS5 verifiable criterion (same RQ5 criterion). The two core KPIs — uncertainty-calibration coverage criterion (RQ5: 90% PI coverage approximately 90% of the time) and decision objective (RQ6: water-use efficiency) — are defined identically across all three sections. No section asserts a different numerical target or a different decision objective. OBJ-3 measurable_target components (RQ4, RQ5, RQ7, RQ9) are all present in all three sections with no partial metric loss: all four RQ4 measurement types (chlorophyll fluorescence, stomatal conductance, canopy and leaf temperature, spectral reflectance) appear in each section that references OBJ-3.

consistency_log.source_basis: impact_section.json sub_sections 2.3.2–2.3.5 and impact_pathway_refs [PWY-EI-01 through PWY-EI-07]; implementation_section.json wp_table_refs and sub_section 3.1. OUT-1 → WP1/D1-01 (confirmed in Implementation). OUT-2 → WP2/D2-01 (confirmed). OUT-3 → WP3/D3-01 (confirmed). OUT-4 → WP2/T2-03/D2-01 (confirmed). OUT-5 → WP5 (confirmed). No impact claim references a WP or deliverable absent from the Implementation section wp_table_refs or deliverable list.

consistency_log.description: Budget and resource claim consistency across all three sections
consistency_log.source_basis: implementation_section.json sub_section 3.1 effort allocation (24 PM total: WP1 8 PM, WP2 7 PM, WP3 5 PM, WP4 2 PM, WP5 2 PM); excellence_section.json sub_sections (references 24-month fellowship duration, WP person-months matching Implementation); impact_section.json (does not assert independent budget or person-month figures). consistency_log.description: Terminology consistency: technical terms, methodology names, and component names across all three sections
consistency_log.source_basis: docs/tier3_project_instantiation/architecture_inputs/objectives.json (canonical component/system names from objective titles); all three section artifacts. Key technical terms are used consistently: 'Route A' (direct probabilistic fusion), 'Route B' (homogeneous-patch proxy), 'AquaCrop', 'water-use efficiency (WUE)', 'honest uncertainty chain', 'TRL 3-4'. The canonical component name 'decision engine' (from OBJ-2 title: 'Uncertainty-aware decision engine for water-use-efficient irrigation choice') appears with its full stem in all three sections; no section uses 'decision' without 'engine' in a way that omits the component keyword. Minor stylistic variations (e.g., 'canopy/leaf temperature' vs 'canopy and leaf temperature'; 'TRL 3-4' vs 'TRL 3–4' en-dash variant) are present but do not introduce contradictions or ambiguity in meaning.

consistency_log.description: Section ordering and completeness: all three sections present in correct Part B order
consistency_log.source_basis: excellence_section.json (schema_id: orch.tier5.excellence_section.v1, criterion: Excellence); impact_section.json (schema_id: orch.tier5.impact_section.v1, criterion: Impact); implementation_section.json (schema_id: orch.tier5.implementation_section.v1, criterion: Implementation). All three criterion-aligned sections are present. Ordering Excellence (1) → Impact (2) → Implementation (3) matches the MSCA-PF Part B application form structure for HORIZON-MSCA-2026-PF-01 as evidenced by section criteria names, sub_section IDs (1.x, 2.x, 3.x), and MSCA-PF instrument type. No application form template files were found in the declared Tier 2A directory (docs/tier2a_instrument_schemas/application_forms/); ordering verification is therefore based on section metadata and instrument type rather than explicit template file cross-reference.

consistency_log.description: Traceability footer consistency: primary_sources non-empty; no_unsupported_claims_declaration consistent with validation_status.overall_status
consistency_log.source_basis: traceability_footer.primary_sources arrays and validation_status.overall_status from all three section artifacts. All three sections have non-empty primary_sources arrays (Excellence: 12 source entries spanning Tier 2 and Tier 3; Impact: 12 source entries; Implementation: 16 source entries). All three sections have no_unsupported_claims_declaration: true with validation_status.overall_status: 'inferred'. The check criterion (flag if true + 'unresolved') is not triggered: none of the three sections has overall_status: 'unresolved'. The 'inferred' status is consistent with no_unsupported_claims_declaration: true, as 'inferred' denotes claims derived by logical reasoning from confirmed evidence rather than unsupported assertions.

consistency_log.source_basis: validation_status.overall_status from all three section artifacts: excellence_section.json (overall_status: 'inferred'); impact_section.json (overall_status: 'inferred'); implementation_section.json (overall_status: 'inferred').
